questions.q: What does the seventh point of the big star on the Australian flag represent?
questions.e: In the video: "Šest krakova predstavlja šest australijskih saveznih država, dok sedmi predstavlja sve australijske teritorije" — six points are the states, while the seventh stands for all the territories.

questions.q: Which constellation is shown on the flags of Australia and New Zealand?
questions.e: In the video: "Te zvezde zajedno formiraju sazvežđe Južni krst." — these stars together form the constellation Southern Cross.

questions.q: Why do Australia and New Zealand not change their flags?
o: They cannot agree who should change it
They are happy with the flags
questions.e: In the video: "Pa zato što ne mogu da se dogovore oko toga ko treba da je menja" — because they cannot agree on who should change it.

questions.q: Which country did Colombia, Venezuela and Ecuador once form together?
questions.e: In the video: "Ove tri države su nekada bile deo Velike Kolumbije" — these three countries were once part of Gran Colombia.

questions.q: What did Francisco de Miranda dream of?
questions.e: In the video: "Njegova skromna vizija je bila da ujedini celu Latinsku Ameriku" — his modest vision was to unite the whole of Latin America.

questions.q: What inspired the colors of the flags of many African countries?
questions.e: In the video: "Etiopija, koja je 1896. uspešno odbila italijanske pokušaje kolonizacije" — Ethiopia, which in 1896 successfully repelled Italian attempts at colonization.

questions.q: What is pan-Slavism?
o: A movement for uniting the Slavic peoples
questions.e: In the video: "Panslavizam je politički pokret koji je za cilj imao oslobođenje" — pan-Slavism is a political movement whose goal was liberation.

questions.q: Whose flag was the Russian tricolor modeled on?
questions.e: In the video: "njihova trobojka je zapravo nastala po uzoru na holandsku trobojku" — their tricolor actually came about modeled on the Dutch tricolor.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Danska zastava je vrlo verovatno *najduže* korišćena zastava na svetu
questions.e: najduže — longest.

questions.q: Ali zaboravljamo još jednog *žrtvu* francuskog dizajna, Andoru
questions.e: žrtva — victim.

questions.q: Kondor na vrhu predstavlja *moć* Ekvadora
questions.e: moć — power.

questions.q: Ovo levo je *lovor* koji predstavlja pobedu republike
questions.e: lovor — laurel.

questions.q: Jer, kao, lako ćeš *slomiti* jedan prut
questions.e: slomiti — to break.

questions.q: Mislim, pazi, svakako je *nebitno* ko je prvi.
questions.e: nebitno — irrelevant.

questions.q: Zelena predstavlja *bogatstvo* i plodnu zemlju, kao i nadu
questions.e: bogatstvo — wealth.

questions.q: Tehnički, ni oni to nisu *ukrali* od Rumuna
questions.e: ukrasti — to steal.

questions.q: Australijanci ne prave baš najbolju razliku između srpske i ruske ___
questions.e: Između + gen.: između srpske i ruske zastave.

questions.q: Ove tri države su nekada bile deo ___ Kolumbije
questions.e: Deo + gen.: deo Velike Kolumbije.

questions.q: ali su sve one otišle u svom ___ sa zastavama
questions.e: U svom smeru — locative: in their own direction.

questions.q: Hrvati su isto odavno koristili ove ___ boje
questions.e: Ove tri boje — numeral tri with the noun in the plural.

questions.q: Srbi su koristili ove boje još ___ 13. veku
questions.e: When? — u + loc.: u 13. veku.

questions.q: Čađani su terali Rumune da ___ zastavu
questions.e: After da a single result takes the perfective: promene.

questions.q: Ekvador je promenio raspored ___
questions.e: Raspored + gen. pl.: raspored pruga.

questions.q: Tako da su zastave ove dve ___ u kombinaciji
questions.e: Dve + gen. sg. (fem.): dve sile.
